description: A single, sharply stated price objection. Must be classified 'observed' with a resolvable source, and the summary/statement must never promise a specific discount or a guaranteed outcome to overcome it. CONVERTED TO v2 (P1.10d-2). The v1 fixture also asserted the gate `fos.objection_intelligence.no-prohibited-guarantee`, which this definition NO LONGER DECLARES — the keyword gate was replaced by the stage-7b semantic classifier in #110. Asserting it would now be a distinct grader failure under design section 5 rule 4 (a fixture naming a gate absent from declared_gate_keys). Stage-7b coverage is asserted via `compliance_review_blocked` instead. v1's `output_schema_constraints` were prose; the mechanizable subset is now `output_assertions`, and the rest stays here, asserted by nothing.
